name: Kaifuku Jutsushi no Yarinaoshi (Redo of Healer)
description:
Bu ortak bilgiye bağlı olan Keare, başkaları tarafından tekrar tekrar sömürüldü. Bir gün, şifa sihrinin ötesinde neler olduğunu fark etti ve şifacının en güçlü sınıf olduğuna ikna oldu. Ancak, bu potansiyeli fark ettiğinde, her şeyden yoksun bırakıldı. Böylece, dört yıl öncesine dönüp her şeyi yeniden yapmaya karar vermek için dünyanın iyileştirici sihrini kullandı.

Bu şifa veren bir büyücünün kahramanca bir hikayesi… (Otomatik çevrilmiştir)

episodes.name: The Healer Starts Over!
episodes.description: With the Demon Lord defeated, Keyaru’s revenge begins. The first step is to rewind time. Followed by planning…

episodes.name: The Healer Ruins Princess Flare!
episodes.description: Flare has a dark side that Keyaru originally didn’t see until it was too late. Forgiveness isn’t something that he’s interested in now. So, he waits…

episodes.name: The Healer Buys a Slave!
episodes.description: One does not forget the past, even if it hasn’t happened yet. Many people remain unpunished. Getting to them may require help, though.

episodes.name: The Healer Acquires Setsuna!
episodes.description: How far will Setsuna go for revenge? Keyarga is curious to know.

episodes.name: The Healer Finds a New Toy!
episodes.description: Keyarga’s actions have not gone unnoticed. He used the Krylet sword technique against Gioral soldiers. And one woman will not let the insult stand.

episodes.name: The Healer Sheds Blood and Tears!
episodes.description: The cost of revenge is steep. Especially when innocents pay the price.

episodes.name: The Healer Executes Justice!
episodes.description: They expected the Hero of Recovery. They planned on him being heroic. Unfortunately for them, Keyarga isn’t a hero.

episodes.name: The Healer Meets the Demon Lord!
episodes.description: Keyarga knows this woman. She will become the Demon Lord and the enemy of all humankind. So, what is she doing in a city where humans and demonic beings coexist?

episodes.name: The Healer Takes Revenge for a Meal!
episodes.description: Keyarga, Freia and Setsuna will protect Eve until she becomes the Demon Lord. But that protection comes at a price: The Philosopher’s Stone.

episodes.name: Şifacı Tek, Güzel Bir Çiçek Oldu!
episodes.description: Bir avcı nasıl yakalanır? Keyarga kendini mükemmel bir yem haline getirir.
